dumps.text: Observation: the younger generation can be more spoiled, in a specific sense. You have to go through real experience before you can really demand something. A child obviously needs its basic needs fulfilled to survive, that part isn't questionable. The issue is young people growing up without separating their emotions, the anger at a parent or authority figure, from their actual needs. That can grow into something obnoxious: thinking you can demand things without having the basics in place first, like mathematics, physics, real competence.
